text:
The animal that says 'meow' is a cat.

The text contains a social engineering tactic known as "pretexting" combined with "flattery" and "false authority." The attacker creates a fabricated scenario (meeting at a conference) to build rapport and trust. They then use flattery by expressing interest in Craig's work to lower his guard. Finally, they create a false sense of urgency and opportunity by claiming to know investors, which serves as the pretext to extract sensitive information (the project proposal) under the guise of a legitimate business opportunity.
